"Zindagi Pyar Ka Geet Hai" is a beautiful, soulful song from the 1983 Bollywood movie Souten, starring Rajesh Khanna and Padmini Kolhapure. The film, directed by Harish Chandra, explores the complex emotions of love, betrayal, and relationships. This particular song became iconic because of its touching lyrics, timeless melody, and the evergreen voice of Lata Mangeshkar.
